Voice now refuses to decide any approval whose capability is high-risk or operator_always, and fails CLOSED when the approval names no capability or its risk cannot be read. capabilities.notes: The gap that decided whether she could be used instead of a chat assistant. EVERY ask went through planner.compile(), which turns English into COMMAND STEPS - right for 'remind me Tuesday', wrong for 'explain this' or 'which should I pick'. For those the planner returned intent 'answer' with nothing executable, the record was retired, and spoken() fell through to plan.summary: a one-line restatement of the question. She was an executor with no mouth. Now a question gets a real answer from the same subscription everything else uses, and carries what a chat assistant elsewhere cannot know - what she is working on, what is waiting for him, his open tasks, whether she is halted - plus the last few exchanges so a follow-up resolves. It ANSWERS AND DOES NOT ACT: the module reaches no executor, and a test asserts it. `clarify` is deliberately NOT routed here (a clarifying question is already the right thing to say; sending it through made it a paragraph about ambiguity). His questions and her answers are not journaled - only that a conversation happened.
